newsitem.title: USA: Timber Lodge Steakhouse chief recuperating.
newsitem.headline: Timber Lodge Steakhouse chief recuperating.

text.p: Timber Lodge Steakhouse Inc said Dermot Rowland, its chairman and chief executive, is expected to resume partial duties in about six weeks after undergoing what the company described as major surgery.
Rowland is expected to make a full recovery, the company said.
As previously announced, Laurence LeJeune will serve as acting chairman and chief executive during Rowland's absence, while Pete Bedzyk will serve as acting president.
Timber Lodge Steakhouse operates a chain of restaurants.
Its shares were unchanged Tuesday at 4-1/2.
